name: cozy-sun-bear
description: Vendored, in-repo copy of the cozy-sun-bear EPUB reader. Consumed directly by app/javascript/packs/cozy-sun-bear/cozy-sun-bear.js via 'cozy-sun-bear': 'link:vendor/javascript/cozy-sun-bear' in the root package.json. There is no standalone build/test pipeline here anymore (no webpack.config.js, no karma test suite) -- coverage for reader behavior lives in heliotrope's own RSpec system specs.
